# Abstract things

### Sensory concepts

| glyph | sound           | meaning                          | combo                     |
| ----- | --------------- | -------------------------------- | ------------------------- |
|       | hema            | feeling                          | air (metaphorical) + body |
|       | gokomi          | sight / figure                   | thing + eye               |
|       | nen'gokomi      | likeness / resemblance           | same + sight              |
|       | yami            | colour                           | light + seeing            |
|       | hefe            | smell                            | air + nose                |
|       | hefi            | sound                            | air + ear                 |
|       | gavahan'tsa     | taste                            | food + (redup. of mouth)  |
|       | gavahan'tsa-van | fruity taste / sweet             | taste + fruit             |
|       | bigavahan       | hunger                           | lack + food               |
|       | bogavahan       | satiety                          | many + food               |
|       | bilu            | thirst / draught                 | lack + water              |
|       | hemate          | touch                            | feeling + hand            |
|       | ksoman'ma       | pain (of the body)               | difficulty + body         |
|       | ksuma           | sickness, illness, disease       | unluck + body             |
|       | ksumahe         | airborne diseases e.g. cold, flu | disease + air             |
|       | ksumaka         | fever                            | disease + heat            |
|       | hemaka          | heat / warmth                    | feeling + fire            |
|       | hemachu         | cold / chill                     | feeling + ice             |
|       | kibi            | hard / strong / tough            | break + little            |
|       | kibo            | brittle                          | break + much              |

|                           | hoyun'wi       | east                                    | side + sun + (rising)             |
|                           | hoyun'wo       | west                                    | side + sun + (lowering)           |
|                           | polari-theho   | north                                   | "Polaris" + direction             |
|                           | oktan-theho    | south                                   | "Octantis" + direction            |
|                           | ksen-an        | displaced / missing / excluded          | removed + (adj)                   |
|                           | hometan        | spatial direction / way / passage       | way + movement                    |
|                           | honon          | front side                              | side + front                      |
|                           | hoben          | back side                               | side + back                       |
### Temporal concepts

| glyph | sound            | meaning                           | combo                      |
| ----- | ---------------- | --------------------------------- | -------------------------- |
|       | in'yuntsu        | during                            | within + time              |
|       | in'thiyuntsu     | before                            | within + (cause) + time    |
|       | in'thayuntsu     | after                             | within + (result) + time   |
|       | yuntsuksun       | past                              | time + finished            |
|       | yuntsumetan      | present                           | time + motion              |
|       | yuntsuzhin       | future                            | time + not yet             |
|       | yuntsu-tsu       | night-time (when the moon is out) | time + moon                |
|       | yuntsu-yun       | day-time (when the sun is out)    | time + sun                 |
|       | koqigun          | day (as in 24 hrs)                | rotation + earth           |
|       | koqigun'yun      | year                              | rotation + the earth + sun |
|       | koqitsu          | month                             | rotation + moon            |
|       | yuntsupya        | childhood                         | time + child               |
|       | yuntsumebon'zhin | teenhood, teen age                |                            |
|       | yuntsumebon      | adulthood                         | time + adult               |
|       | yuntsuzho        | elderhood, old age                | time + elder               |
|       | nizhozhin        | age                               | measurement + aging        |
### Question/Indefinite Words

| glyph | sound        | meaning                                 | combo            |
| ----- | ------------ | --------------------------------------- | ---------------- |
|       | meshi        | who / someone                           | person + what    |
|       | thatsehyashi | why / for what reason / for some reason | intention + what |
|       | hoshi        | how / in what way / somehow             | way + what       |
|       | gogun'shi    | where / somewhere                       | land + what      |
|       | yuntsushi    | when / sometime                         | time + what      |
|       | nishi        | how many / how much / some (amount)     | number + what    |
|       | etseshi      | which / whichever                       | choices + what   |
|       | kome         | everyone                                | all + person     |
|       | kogoko       | everything                              | all + thing      |
|       | kogogun      | everywhere                              | all + land       |
|       | koyuntsu     | always / every time                     | all + time       |
|       | ksome        | noone                                   | no + person      |
|       | ksogoko      | nothing                                 | no + thing       |
|       | ksogogun     | nowhere                                 | no + land        |
|       | ksoyuntsu    | never                                   | no + time        |
|       | ksoetse      | none / neither                          | no + choices     |
|       | meshietse    | others                                  | who + other      |
### Metalanguage

| glyph | sound         | meaning                             | combo                           |
| ----- | ------------- | ----------------------------------- | ------------------------------- |
|       | jabin-(nihin) | morpheme (smallest unit of meaning) | word + small + [first]         |
|       | jabin-nifun   | sub-word                            | word + small + second           |
|       | jabon         | compound word                       | word + big                      |
|       | ja-en'tse     | verb                                | word + (vrb) + (<-semantic)     |
|       | ja-an'tse     | adjective                           | word + (adj) + (<-semantic)     |
|       | jagoko        | noun / name                         | word + thing                    |
|       | hefibinja     | syllable                            | sound + small + word            |
|       | gen'ja        | etymology                           | origin + word                   |
|       | sen'noja      | meaning / definition                | information + word              |
|       | jashitse      | question                            | word + what + (<-semantic)      |
|       | ja-un'tse     | condition / context / case          | word + (context) + (<-semantic) |
|       | sen'hefi      | onomatopoeia                        | writing + sound                 |
### Pronouns

| glyph | sound      | meaning     | combo                   |
| ----- | ---------- | ----------- | ----------------------- |
|       | mein       | I / me      | person + inside         |
|       | meon       | you         | person + outside        |
|       | meon'tso   | you all     | you + (plural)          |
|       | mein'tso   | we / us     | me + (plural)           |
|       | medo       | he / him    | person + male           |
|       | mebu       | she / her   | person + female         |
|       | memeon     | they / them | person + person + (far) |
|       | gokoin     | this        | thing + (near)          |
|       | gokoon     | that / it   | thing + (far)           |
|       | gokoin'tso | these       | this + (plural)         |
|       | gokoon'tso | those       | that + (plural)         |
|       |            |             |                         |
### Grammar

| glyph                    | sound                      | meaning                                                             | combo                                 |
| ------------------------ | -------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------- |
|                          | etseko                     | any                                                                 | other/choices + all                   |
|                          | otseun                     | in addition / also                                                  | addition + (context)                  |
|                          | otsenen'un                 | again / another time / once more                                    | repetition + (context)                |
|                          | dun'zhin'un                | can ... / could ... / may ... / might ... (in terms of possibility) | possibility (minus "tse") + (context) |
|                          | toun                       | able to ... / can ... (in terms of ability)                         | ability + (context)                   |
|                          | in'yuntsu-piun ... un, ... | while (clause), ...                                                 | during + of + (context)               |
|                          | yuntsu-piun ... un, ....   | when (clause), ...                                                  | time + of + (context)                 |
|                          | pidha                      | (relative clause) / that / which / who                              | of + (subj)                           |
|                          | un'dha                     | (turns the preceding clause into the subject) / ...ing ... is       | (context) + (subj)                    |
|                          | ()eksoun                   | Whether or not ...                                                  | or + not + (context)                  |
|                          | ()eksoun'dha               | Whether or not ... is                                               | or + not + (context) + (subj)         |
|                          | thiun                      | (agent marker)                                                      | because + (context)                   |
|                          | thikso                     | despite / even though                                               | because + not                         |
|                          | -thigoko                   | (non-human agent causative verb)                                    | because + thing                       |
